name: my-ai
description: Claude Code via the Headroom compression proxy — CLI + TTY dashboard + Tauri GUI/systray (rebrand of claude-superset).

build._remote_note: Rust/Tauri compile is heavy — built on GHA (ship-my-ai-app.yml), published to a rolling GH release, pulled on the laptop. Never compiled locally (freeze-guard).
build._arch_note: my-ai + my-ai-dash are pure Rust → built for both arches (assets suffixed -x86_64 / -aarch64). my-ai-gui (Tauri/webkit) is desktop-only → built on gui_arches only. Termux (aarch64) pulls cli+dash; desktop (x86_64) pulls the trio.

desktop.comment: Claude Code via the Headroom compression proxy — launcher + infra dashboard + systray
